remarks: Redesigned for elevated living, this fully renovated 4-bedroom home combines open-concept style with seamless functional flow, offering near single-level living on a private, scenic lot. An inviting entry opens into an informal living room with a cozy fireplace, a high-impact great room featuring soaring cathedral ceilings, stylish beams, and French doors that flood the space with natural light. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen boasts exceptional counter space, professional-grade appliances, and a massive center island with seating for effortless entertaining or ease of everyday living. The main living space opens to a private wrap-around back porch with built-in corner seating & planters, perfect for outdoor relaxation overlooking the tranquil, tree-lined yard with an area for a garden.A separate wing houses the private primary suite-a serene retreat styled with shiplap walls, vaulted ceilings, large picture window, and spa-inspired bath complete with dual sinks, a freestanding soaking tub, a custom marble shower, and skylights. Three additional light-filled bedrooms and a full bath provide comfortable accommodations for guests or family.Complete with an attached 2-car garage, lower level flexible space and laundry, storage shed, and a lush, rolling lawn.This turnkey residence offers easy living just minutes from everyday conveniences, award-winning New Canaan schools, the Nature Center, Waveny Park, designer boutiques, NYC-inspired dining & the Metro North train
